newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein stable, trade quiet.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein stable, trade quiet.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were generally stable in late trading on Tuesday, with sluggish trade in Malaysia coupled with an overnight fall in Chicago soyoil futures keeping interest thin, traders said.
They said palm olein was quoted at 1,395-1,400 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, unchanged from the opening, but offers were also heard at five rupiah above and below the market range.

"The market is getting slow again on a lack of fresh factors and direction," one trader said. "Buyers are waiting for prices to weaken further, but I don't think prices will go down much more unless crude palm oil prices decline."
Traders said there was no refining margin at the current level of palm olein prices. Crude palm oil prices was last done at around 1,230 rupiah/kg in the North Sumatran city of Medan.
Local palm olein prices have fallen by about seven percent over the last four weeks on the back of weak demand.
